description: Create this agent's DFM APP WALLET without a browser. The owner key is generated and stays on THIS machine (reused if it exists, never overwritten); DFM only receives the public key. Call it again if the wallet needs re-linking. Needs a SIWS sign-in (a local keypair, DFM_AGENT_KEYPAIR_PATH) — a dfm_ API key cannot create an app wallet. Idempotent: returns the existing app wallet if there is one. Moves no funds.
name: create_app_wallet
title: Create my app wallet (headless)
